senses.zh_definition: 法蒂玛；源自阿拉伯语的女性名字，与 Fatimah 为相关拼写形式。
senses.en_definition: Fatima, a feminine personal name of Arabic origin, related in spelling to Fatimah.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas perempuan yang berasal daripada bahasa Arab dan mempunyai bentuk ejaan berkaitan, Fatimah.
senses.nuances: 此处按女性人名解释，名词类别具体为专有名词，不是已证实的普通马来语词条。输入没有上下文，不能确定具体人物，也不能排除其他专名用途。Fatima 与 Fatimah 不应在个人证件中随意互换；本条不把人名身份标成普通词汇的 official 状态。下列为人名称呼组合，并非固定词组或经统计验证的高频搭配。[姓名资料：Fatima](https://www.behindthename.com/name/fatima)。

etymology.historical_story: Fatima comes from the Arabic personal name Fāṭima, associated etymologically with weaning. Its cultural prominence is closely connected with Fatima, the daughter of the Prophet Muhammad. The name travelled across Muslim communities in several spelling forms. In Malay contexts, Fatimah is also familiar, but an individual's recorded spelling should always be preserved. [Source: Fatima, meaning and history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/fatima).
